## Full Prompts Used

### logo-primary
Professional brand identity design for Shanghai Innovation Institute (SII). Create a primary abstract symbol only: a modular intelligent-grid mark built from three vertical S/I/I-like structural columns, neural network nodes, fork-and-merge paths, and a sharp breakthrough cut suggesting the Chinese ideas of innovation plus intelligence. Style: Swiss design principles, precise geometric construction, institutional but experimental, not a commercial AI startup. Use deep space blue #071B3A as the field, intelligent cyan #00D4FF as the main signal, with subtle accents of energy purple #6E5BFF, raster green #32E6A1, and innovation orange #FF7A1A. Motifs: five research fronts expressed as five tiny node clusters around the core grid; West Bund glass/urban light translated into clean reflective linework. No text, no letters, no Chinese characters, pure symbol, no stock icons, no generic AI blue-gradient slop.
